description: Adversaries may use password spraying to attempt access to accounts when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are obtained. Password spraying uses a single password or a small set of passwords against many different accounts to avoid account lockouts that would normally occur when brute forcing a single account with many passwords.
artifacts: multiple failed authentication attempts across different accounts
authentication attempts using common passwords against multiple usernames
SSH connection attempts with same password across different accounts
authentication failure responses from multiple accounts
patterned authentication behavior (same password, different users)
authentication attempts spread over time to avoid lockouts
successful authentication after multiple failed attempts on different accounts
